147051.overview: Futari wa Pretty Cure (ふたりはプリキュア) is a Sega Pico game based on the Futari wa Pretty Cure television show.

147419.overview: Fishing Pico: Donald no Adventure Fishing (フィッシングピコ ドナルドのアドベンチャーフィッシング) is a package for the Sega Pico, containing a Fishing Pico and the game, Donald no Adventure Fishing (ドナルドのアドベンチャーフィッシング), which was not sold separately.
